Login via API + localStorage token: menu shows Account/My-list/Esci. Avatar picker: chose purple, /api/auth/me returns profileImage=purple, header-avatar src updates to /avatars/purple.webp. issues: Console warning: '<svg> attribute width: Expected length, "auto".' repeats 10x. RankNumber SVG is being rendered with width='auto' before getBBox measures. Cosmetic, not visible, but pollutes console. Consider defaulting width to a numeric px before measurement (e.g. width={measured || 0}).
Top10 poster img height=172.5px vs horizontal video-card img height=168.09px (diff 4.4px). Spec tolerance is 4px so this is marginal; visually not noticeable but exceeds tolerance by 0.4px.
